# M0-S2: a package must not mix .go and .lgo files.
# logos build fails with correctness::mixed_package naming both files.

env GOPROXY=off

! logos build .
stderr '\[correctness::mixed_package\] cannot mix \.go files \(a\.go\) and \.lgo files \(b\.lgo\) in one package'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/nomix

go 1.27

-- a.go --
package main

func A() int { return 1 }

-- b.lgo --
package main

func B() int { return 2 }

func main() {}
